text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for inference.gw.prod (us-west-2) starting ~08:12 UTC. Error rate spike from 0.3% -> 12%. Automatic paging to #incidents. https://metrics.redwood.example/alerts/5234

alice-oncall: I'm oncall, looking. Paging @sanjay-runtime @jessica-sre. Any quick context?

sanjay-runtime: seeing repeated segfaults and OOMs in model-runner on pod set model-runner-ggx*. Kernel logs show GPU reset followed by SIGSEGV in libattention.so. Sample from kubectl logs:
```
[2026-03-15T08:12:04Z] model-runner[pid=4123] fatal:  segfault at 0 ip 0x7f3c1b2a libattention.so+0x1423
[2026-03-15T08:12:05Z] kernel: NVRM: GPU 000:02:00: resets detected: 1
OOM killer invoked: model-runner (pid 4123)
```

jessica-sre: sweet spot for mitigation: drain affected nodes, scale up fallback pool (cpu-backed) and enable gateway fastfail to smaller model. Also check k8s eviction events.

alice-oncall: running drain on node gpu-w-22 now: `kubectl drain gpu-w-22 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

rookie-dev: noticed requests that triggered long contexts (~4096 tokens) correlate with crash timestamps. Could be KV cache growth + quantized attention kernel issues.

sanjay-runtime: good catch. We should enable per-request max_length clamp to 2048 at gateway level for now and flip in-flight routing to model-variant:llama-7b-q8-fallback. Pushing rule: `route.set_fallback('llama-7b-q8-fallback', threshold=0.05)`

maria-cs: FYI: initial customer impact — 503/502 errors reported by AcmeCorp and BetaSpace around 08:12–08:20 UTC. Customer telemetry shows ~4% of requests failing end-to-end for those tenants. CS will notify customers once we have mitigation timeline.

jessica-sre: verified node drain completed, cordoned gpu-w-22. K8s shows pods rescheduled to gpu-w-25, but model-runner on gpu nodes still occasionally OOMs. Starting autoscaler to spin additional gpu nodes + ramp cpu fallback pool.

sanjay-runtime: deployed hotpatch v0.9.1 to model-runner with added guard in attention kernel to limit KV cache growth. Rolling restart of model-runner replicas in batches of 3.

alice-oncall: toggled gateway fallback routing and max_length clamp. Monitoring for 5xx drop. Metrics: error rate down to 1.8% at 08:30 UTC. Latency back to normal for most customers.

maria-cs: posting interim update to impacted customers: "We've identified a runtime OOM/segfault causing elevated 5xx. Mitigations in place: node drain, fallback routing, and hotpatch. We're continuing to monitor and will follow up with RCA."

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial. Next steps: postmortem runbook assigned to @sanjay-runtime and @jessica-sre. Severity: Sev2. Incident channel created: #incident-3299999999 for detailed bridge. :thumbsup:
